kiosk_user.title: Kiosk mode for a user
kiosk_user.description:
Pick the user. Each user can have their own dashboard. Tip: create a separate user for a wall tablet.

Turn kiosk mode on or off any time with the **Kiosk mode** switch (all kiosk users) or the **Kiosk + user name** switch for one user.

kiosk.title: Kiosk mode for {user}
kiosk.description: What {user} sees when they open Home Assistant. On any device, add ?kiosk=off to the address to turn kiosk mode off for that browser tab, or ?kiosk to turn it on.

data.lock: Keep this user on that dashboard
data.remove: Delete kiosk mode for this user

data_description.enabled: Turn it on or off here, or with the switch "Kiosk + user name" from a dashboard or automation. The settings below are kept while it is off.
data_description.view: Path of one view, e.g. "cameras". Leave empty for the dashboard's first view.
data_description.lock: If they open any other page, they are sent back to this dashboard.
data_description.remove: Removes this user's kiosk set-up and its switch.

sidebar.title: Hide sidebar items
sidebar.description: Items to hide from the sidebar. They are only hidden, not locked: the page still opens from its address.

data_description.hide_for_admins: When off, administrators still see every item.
